en: A vintage colorized postcard showing a tall, narrow brick Gothic-style building on a street corner. The façade has large pointed-arch windows and a decorative clock or sign with a sun emblem near the top. The ground floor houses a shop with red-painted storefront and signage, and a few people stand on the sidewalk in front. Surrounding structures are older European townhouses. A green postage stamp with a circular Bruges postmark is visible in the upper right corner. The caption at the bottom identifies the scene as a house associated with Charles V in Bruges.
